description: This file implements Android network-related functions for Chromium, including DNS server retrieval, certificate verification, network binding, and socket tagging, using JNI calls and dynamic library loading.

methods.name: GetUserAddedRoots
methods.description: Retrieves user-added root certificates via JNI.

methods.name: VerifyX509CertChain
methods.description: Verifies server certificate chain using JNI call.

methods.name: AddTestRootCertificate
methods.description: Adds a test root certificate via JNI.

methods.name: ClearTestRootCertificates
methods.description: Clears all test root certificates via JNI.

methods.name: IsCleartextPermitted
methods.description: Checks if cleartext traffic is permitted for a host via JNI.

methods.name: HaveOnlyLoopbackAddresses
methods.description: Checks if only loopback addresses are present via JNI.

methods.name: GetMimeTypeFromExtension
methods.description: Retrieves MIME type from file extension via JNI.

methods.name: GetTelephonyNetworkOperator
methods.description: Gets the network operator string via JNI.

methods.name: GetIsRoaming
methods.description: Checks if device is roaming via JNI.

methods.name: GetIsCaptivePortal
methods.description: Checks for captive portal status via JNI.

methods.name: GetWifiSSID
methods.description: Retrieves current Wi-Fi SSID via JNI.

methods.name: SetWifiEnabledForTesting
methods.description: Enables or disables Wi-Fi for testing via JNI.

methods.name: GetWifiSignalLevel
methods.description: Gets Wi-Fi signal strength level via JNI.

methods.name: GetDnsServersInternal
methods.description: Internal helper to parse DNS server info from JNI result.

methods.name: GetCurrentDnsServers
methods.description: Retrieves current DNS servers for default network.

methods.name: GetDnsServersForNetwork
methods.description: Retrieves DNS servers for a specific network.

methods.name: ReportBadDefaultNetwork
methods.description: Reports a bad default network via JNI.

methods.name: TagSocket
methods.description: Tags a socket with UID and tag via JNI.

methods.name: BindToNetwork
methods.description: Binds a socket to a specific network, supporting different Android SDK versions.

methods.name: GetAddrInfoForNetwork
methods.description: Performs getaddrinfo for a specific network, supporting different Android SDK versions.
